description: PQS terrain height for Kerbin and Mun sampled in the running game with the live PQSMod stack (FLIGHT scene, vessel on the KSC launch pad). h_surface = pqsController.GetSurfaceHeight(GetRelSurfaceNVector(lat, lon)) (public API, overrideQuadBuildCheck=false: PQSMod_FlattenArea/MapDecal(Tangent) only apply where their quad is active), h_override = the internal GetSurfaceHeight(..., overrideQuadBuildCheck: true) used by Vessel ground positioning (all flatten/decal mods apply regardless of quads). terrain_alt = h_surface - pqsController.radius (= CelestialBody.TerrainAltitude(lat, lon, allowNegative: true)). Sets: global_1deg (lat -90..90, lon -180..179), ksc_0.01deg (lat -0.60..0.40, lon -75.06..-74.06 at 0.01 deg, lat/lon computed as start + i*0.01 in double).
oracles: PQS.GetSurfaceHeight with the PQSMod stack of the PSystem prefab (sorted by order, disabled mods removed)

provenance.decimal_format: normalized from _hex by harness/captures/tools/normalize.py (harness ExactNumber.FormatFloat/FormatDouble on .NET Framework ToString G6..G9 / G15..G17)
